test_policy: Same frozen historical holdout for final comparisons only; never tune on it. Previously evaluated historical data is not a fresh production holdout.
training: Damage-only task views, repeat-factor sampling threshold 0.2, no unannotated part-only images as negatives, publisher COCO-pretrained weights
selection: Best validation damage bbox mAP50:95; report precision/recall/FP at common threshold 0.25 and separately at validation-selected operating point. Evaluate selected checkpoint per candidate on the same test images after training.
segmentation_checkpoint_selection: The framework tracks native mask AP. For the common bbox comparison evaluate its mask-selected best, final checkpoint and retained 5-epoch checkpoints on validation only, then select the best available bbox checkpoint. Report native mask metrics separately.
ablation_limit: Resolution and LR both change in the 512 candidate; the segmentation candidate also enables the framework bbox/mask-aware crop augmentation to address small damage. These are practical tuning comparisons, not controlled attributions to one factor.
threshold_selection: Validation only, thresholds 0.25 through 0.95 to preserve the existing API confidence floor: maximize F2 subject to precision >= 0.70 where feasible. If infeasible report that fact; do not invent a feasible operating point. Both tasks are capped at 100 detections per image as required by the API.
resource_comparison: Fresh isolated ONNX CPU processes, 2 inference threads, same photo and repeat count; report session load, median/p95 photo pipeline latency and native process peak RSS. These are local measurements, not Railway deployment results.

local_cpu_selection_envelope.scope: Engineering comparison assumption across all three benchmark photos; not an asserted Railway quota and excludes assistant/JVM overhead.

additional_requirements: Fresh independent production-like holdout with verified clean and non-vehicle negatives
Per-class support and expert semantic label review
Actual Railway CPU/RAM limit load test
All dataset/framework/weight provenance and notices retained
